attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: body_weight_measurement_logging
steps:
  - id: receive_measurement
    op: capture_input
    params:
      fields:
        - name: user_id
          type: string
          required: true
        - name: weight_kg
          type: number
          required: true
        - name: measurement_date
          type: date
          required: true
        - name: measurement_time
          type: time
          required: true
    output: raw_measurement

  - id: validate_plausible_range
    op: validate
    params:
      input: raw_measurement.weight_kg
      rules:
        - condition: "weight_kg >= 30 AND weight_kg <= 300"
          on_fail: reject
          error_message: "Weight measurement outside plausible range (30-300 kg). Measurement rejected."
    output: validated_measurement

  - id: check_existing_measurement_today
    op: query
    params:
      source: weight_measurements
      filters:
        user_id: raw_measurement.user_id
        measurement_date: raw_measurement.measurement_date
    output: existing_today

  - id: warn_duplicate_daily_entry
    op: conditional
    params:
      condition: "existing_today.count > 0"
      on_true:
        op: notify_user
        params:
          user_id: raw_measurement.user_id
          message: "You already have a weight measurement logged for today. Only one measurement per day is recommended. The new measurement will overwrite the previous one."
      on_false:
        op: noop

  - id: store_measurement
    op: upsert
    params:
      target: weight_measurements
      key:
        user_id: raw_measurement.user_id
        measurement_date: raw_measurement.measurement_date
      data:
        user_id: raw_measurement.user_id
        weight_kg: validated_measurement.weight_kg
        measurement_date: raw_measurement.measurement_date
        measurement_time: raw_measurement.measurement_time
        recorded_at: "{{ now() }}"
    output: stored_measurement

  - id: confirm_logged
    op: notify_user
    params:
      user_id: raw_measurement.user_id
      message: "Weight measurement of {{ validated_measurement.weight_kg }} kg on {{ raw_measurement.measurement_date }} has been logged successfully."
